messages:
Zoë (Content): Pushing a fresh draft of the launch post up to the CMS. Includes benchmark highlight + hero webinar CTA. Need quick passes: Legal for claims, Demand Gen for gating/modal copy + HS fields, Growth for headline options, Ops for publish timing. Can everyone check by EOD today? :hourglass:
Raj (Product): Paste the benchmark sentence here so I can confirm baseline and toolchain used. Also call out which model checkpoints we referenced.
Zoë (Content): Draft line:
"In our tests, Redwood Inference achieved up to a 47% reduction in per-token serving cost compared to a stock PyTorch FP16 runtime on long-context 8k workloads; methodology linked below."
Hero CTA: "Try the demo + register for the launch webinar".
Hannah (Legal): Good hedging with "in our tests". Prefer phrasing: "up to 47% in our tests" and require a visible methodology link. Also swap the quality clause to: "while maintaining comparable automated-evaluation metrics (see methodology)". Hardware, batch size, quantization and exact commands must be in the appendix.
Luis (Demand Gen): Recommend gating the benchmark slides and making the recording public after 7 days. HubSpot config I need in the draft (example):
formId: "hs_launch_fall2026"; hiddenFields: ["utm_source","utm_campaign","product_interest","company_size"]; redirect: "/thanks/launch-slides".
Ellen (Growth): Headline A/B suggestions: (A) "Cut inference cost, keep latency predictable" vs (B) "Inference that scales for production". Add CTA UTM: /blog/redwood-inference-launch?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=launch_fall so we can separate traffic. Target CTR -> reg conversion benchmarks: 6% CTR -> 18% regs.
Tom (Ops): Proposed publish window: Thu 2026-10-07 09:00 PT with partner embargo at 08:30 PT. I'll queue the CMS publish but need final permalink and OG image. I'll test the HS form in staging Wed 16:00 PT.
Raj (Product): Confirming infra: A10G cluster, test script: pytorch_bench.sh --fp16 --no_xformers --seq_len 8192 --batch 1 --seed 42. Model checkpoints: rwinf-v1, rwinf-v1-quant. I'll upload variant table to the runbook.
Hannah (Legal): I'll sign off if the appendix link is present on the draft and the language adjusts per above. Also prefer we avoid the isolated BLEU mention unless we publish the full eval table.
Luis (Demand Gen): Modal copy draft: "Get the benchmark slides + ops checklist". Will wire the HS form and CTA redirect. Also request hidden field for "model_interest" values: hosted/dedicated/private.
Ellen (Growth): I'll add the two headlines to CMS for a headline A/B and tie the CTA to the UTM string above.
Tom (Ops): Staging checklist:
- CMS draft in staging
- canonical + OG image uploaded
- HS form configured in staging + test submission
- CTA UTMs applied
- embargo scheduled in CMS
- CDN purge plan ready
I'll run the full preflight Wed 16:00 PT and report results.
Zoë (Content): Linking internal runbook: <internal.link>/benchmarks/redwood-inference-oct2026-runbook. I've added appendix with hardware, exact commands, seeds, model variants and evaluation datasets. Adjusted the language per Hannah.
Hannah (Legal): Reviewing appendix now. If the appendix is live on the draft page I'll approve the phrasing.
Tom (Ops): Staging HS form test: PASS. Redirect to /thanks/launch-slides verified, hidden fields captured. All good for publish flow.
cms-bot: Scheduled publish job queued: 2026-10-07T09:00:00-07:00 (blog/redwood-inference-launch).
Zoë (Content): Thanks all 680 locking timeline. Please react when your task is complete so I can close this thread. :rocket:
